description: This file implements the SearchToolRegistry class that manages CRUD operations for search tools in a database, including adding, deleting, updating, and retrieving search tool configurations using an async interface with Prisma ORM. It also contains utility functions for converting database model instances to dictionaries with ISO formatted datetime strings.

classes.name: SearchToolRegistry
classes.description: A class responsible for managing search tools within a database and in memory, supporting adding, updating, deleting, and retrieving search tool configurations asynchronously.

methods.name: dict _convert_prisma_to_dict(prisma_obj)
methods.description: Converts a Prisma database result object into a dictionary, formatting datetime fields into ISO strings.

methods.name: add_search_tool_to_db( self, search_tool: SearchTool, prisma_client: PrismaClient )
methods.description: Asynchronously adds a new search tool configuration to the database using Prisma, returning the stored configuration with its ID and timestamps.

methods.name: delete_search_tool_from_db( self, search_tool_id: str, prisma_client: PrismaClient )
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a search tool by ID from the database, returning a success message and the name of the deleted tool.

methods.name: update_search_tool_in_db( self, search_tool_id: str, search_tool: SearchTool, prisma_client: PrismaClient )
methods.description: Asynchronously updates an existing search tool configuration in the database and returns the updated record.

methods.name: List[SearchTool] get_all_search_tools_from_db( prisma_client: PrismaClient, )
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves all search tools from the database, returning a list of SearchTool objects.

methods.name: Optional[SearchTool] get_search_tool_by_id_from_db( self, search_tool_id: str, prisma_client: PrismaClient )
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a search tool by its ID, returning a SearchTool object or None.

methods.name: Optional[SearchTool] get_search_tool_by_name_from_db( self, search_tool_name: str, prisma_client: PrismaClient )
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a search tool by its name, returning a SearchTool object or None.

ctags.name: update_search_tool_in_db
ctags.signature: ( self, search_tool_id: str, search_tool: SearchTool, prisma_client: PrismaClient )
